race.comment: LITTLE MISS VALLEY (2) turned in a much better run at her latest appearance, finishing second over 1690m at Kilmore. Has the benefit of a good draw. Meeting a deeper field this time but she has the ability to mix it with them. CALABASAS (1) scored at Melton three runs ago. Returned to something like that form last time out when second over 1720m at Melton, beaten 9 metres. Sure to enjoy an economical run from this draw. Meets some better types this time but a win is not out of the question. BOUTIKA (3) placed from a standing start last time and won three in a row prior, one of them here. Draws to make an impact. KAMARAN (9) is worth thought off a last-start win by a nose at this track over 1690m.
